observations.name: cpkt
observations.normalization: reference returns a packed record of leaf components (uncovered window bytes dropped); compared with the concatenated leaf slices of the expected byte window
observations.difference: reference applies the parent conversion to every component field; the contract refuses non-identity parent conversions instead of guessing inheritance (raw packed bytes matched)
observations.contractNote: reference returns values; the contract refuses this channel: Text and byte-array channels support only identity conversion.
